title: Summit Mileage Expiry and Reinstatement Schedule
content:
Whether award miles in a Crestline Summit Loyalty Program membership can expire through inactivity depends on the tier held. The inactivity period, the reinstatement window and the reinstatement fee ladder are the same at every tier.

| Tier | Miles can expire through inactivity | Months without qualifying activity before expiry | Reinstatement window (calendar days after the forfeiture) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Summit Member | Yes | 24 | 180 |
| Summit Silver | No | 24 | 180 |
| Summit Gold | No | 24 | 180 |
| Summit Platinum | No | 24 | 180 |
| Summit Diamond | No | 24 | 180 |
| Summit Chairman | No | 24 | 180 |

### Reinstatement fee ladder (all tiers)

Bands are chosen by the miles reinstated; both bounds of each band are inclusive.

| Miles reinstated | Fee (USD) |
|---|---|
| 1 to 30000 | 150 |
| 30001 to 75000 | 250 |
| 75001 to 999999999 | 400 |

**Reading the ladder (hypothetical amounts).** 30000 miles sit in the first band at 150 USD; 30001 miles sit in the second band at 250 USD; 75000 miles are still in the second band; 75001 miles fall in the third band at 400 USD.

Only Summit Member has miles that expire through inactivity; at every elite tier the 24-month period has no effect while the tier is held.
